content: Burp MCP server (analyzed by darkdrag0nite) had indirect prompt injection: malicious page content processed by an LLM agent could override the user's prompt and command Burp's MCP tools; config-read functions had no filtering (leaked credentials) though config-edit had warnings; no domain scoping restricted where the agent's HTTP calls could go. Fix in v1.1.0 added configurable domain scoping for HTTP requests. Recommended: separate toggle for config-read tools, explicit per-action approval instead of allow-always, credential filtering.
